text:
Anya: Hey team — quick proposal: shift weekly triage from Thursday 11am to Wednesday 3pm to get better EU overlap. Keep it 30m but add a 15m async prep window before the call where owners paste a 1-line status + blockers. Thoughts? :thinking:

Oliver: 3pm works for me, avoids my Thu design review. Can we timebox owners to ~2m each so we stay under 30m?

Jamal: I prefer 2pm personally — 3pm collides with a couple of customer calls. If we pick 3pm can we alternate every other week to 2pm?

Kai: 3pm tends to be the best overlap for EU folks. Alternating adds friction though — one fixed slot is easier to schedule.

Laura: Async prep sounds great. Suggested prep format: one-line status; PR numbers (if any); request for triage (assign/close/escalate).

Anya: Nice. I'll add a tiny template. Example snippet:
```
Owner: @Laura
Status: investigating flaky ingest
PR: #412
Request: assign to infra for logs
```

Oliver: Can we add a 'hot regressions' quick slot at the top (5m) to catch anything breaking prod?

Jamal: Yes — proposed agenda: 1) hot regressions (5m) 2) owners' async notes (10m sync) 3) backlog triage (10m) 4) action items + follow-ups (5m).

Kai: That fits in 30m. +1 to keeping the timebox.

Anya: Plan: move to Wed 15:00 weekly, keep 30m, add 15m async prep window starting 14:45 where owners drop notes in the thread/pinned doc. Also rotate a weekly "chair" (owner) to run the call.

Laura: Who volunteers to own the rotation? Can we make a 4-week roster and automate invites via CalendarBot?

CalendarBot: @channel Event created: "Weekly Eng Triage" — Wednesdays 15:00-15:30 recurring weekly. Invite sent to #eng calendar.

deploy-bot: reminder: please pin prep notes 15m before the meeting :calendar:

Anya: I'll draft the 4-week roster and post it here by EOD. If no objections I'll update the calendar event and the pinned doc. :thumbsup:

Oliver: Sounds good from me.

Jamal: ok

Kai: +1

Laura: +1
